name: Amos
title: Amos — Plumb Line over Injustice
tagline: Let justice roll down like waters.
audience: Northern kingdom fat on religion and oppression.
purpose: Condemn sinful injustice and empty worship.
christ: Rebuild David’s tent (9:11 → Acts 15); true justice embodied.
jesus_in_this_book: Rebuild David’s tent (9:11 → Acts 15); true justice embodied.
